summary.zh: 规划付费获客预算并测算各渠道 CAC
summary.en: Plan paid acquisition budgets and compute per-channel CAC

description.zh: 在分配预算前规划 Google、LinkedIn、Meta 等渠道的需求获取投入，测算混合与分渠道的获客成本，并定义 MQL 到 SQL 的交接标准。适合年度或季度预算评审。
description.en: Plans demand generation across Google, LinkedIn and Meta before spend is allocated, computes blended and per-channel CAC, and defines MQL to SQL handoff criteria. Useful for budget reviews.
